title: 八卦离散动力学的三个G1模型

interpretation.tick: each fixed-rule update takes the same stipulated duration delta_t=1 in an arbitrary fixed time unit
interpretation.one_line: exactly one of the three positions flips
interpretation.potential: one_line reflexive-transitive closure, allowing zero or several flips
interpretation.DemoK: all states except 000, an arbitrary test constraint, not an evaluation of 坤
interpretation.shared_context: same encoding, objects, scale, and symbols; only tick interpretation varies
